subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution?

options.text: To develop the spirit of inquiry
To develop the spirit of harmony

solution:
The correct answer is __**To bring reform.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• "To bring reform" is **not** a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution.
 
• **"To develop humanism" **is a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution.
 
• **"To develop the spirit of inquiry"** is a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution.
 
• **"To develop the spirit of harmony"** is a fundamental duty mentioned in the Indian Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental duties** are the moral obligations of all citizens to help promote a** spirit of patriotism** and to uphold the unity of India.
 
• Fundamental Duties were recommended by the **Swaran Singh Committee** in** 1976**, and their importance became apparent during the **internal emergency** of **1975–1977. **
 
• The fundamental duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the **42ⁿd Amendment Act in 1976.**
 
• Both people and the country are subject to the obligations outlined in **Part IV–A of the Constitution.**
 
• There are** 11 fundamental duties** mentioned in the Indian Constitution.
